Eloundou et al. 2023 — breadth of LLM task exposure, skewed to high-wage work
value: Our findings reveal that around 80% of the U.S. workforce could have at least 10% of their work tasks affected by the introduction of LLMs, while approximately 19% of workers may see at least 50% of their tasks impacted.

claim_text: Brynjolfsson, Li & Raymond 2023 — productivity gain concentrated in low-skill workers
value: Access to the tool increases productivity, as measured by issues resolved per hour, by 14% on average, including a 34% improvement for novice and low-skilled workers but with minimal impact on experienced and highly skilled workers.

claim_text: Humlum & Vestergaard 2025 — no significant near-term effect on earnings or hours
value: Using difference-in-differences and employer policies as quasi-experimental variation, we estimate precise zeros: AI chatbots have had no significant impact on earnings or recorded hours in any occupation, with confidence intervals ruling out effects larger than 1%.
